description:
Follow-up to bl-45e7. That ball's stated diagnosis (missing llvm-tools-preview) was wrong — adding the component was a defensible defensive change for `--engine llvm`, but the actual failure on workflow run 25027967885 is two integration tests panicking because the runner has no `git config --global user.email` / `user.name`:

- tests/prompt_end_to_end.rs:113 — `prompt_subcommand_compacts_and_merges_conversation_to_main` fails with `git ["commit", "-m", "init conversation repo"] exited with exit status: 128: Author identity unknown ... fatal: empty ident name (for <runner@...>) not allowed`
- tests/merge_ours.rs:161 — `merge_ours_discipline_holds_against_subagent_merge_back` fails the same way during rebase

Locally tests pass because mudbungie@gmail.com is configured globally. The runner is a fresh ubuntu-latest with no identity.

Fix: add a step in .github/workflows/ci.yml before `make ci` that runs:
  git config --global user.email \"ci@lernie.local\"
  git config --global user.name \"lernie CI\"

(Alternative — set identity inside the test setup helpers — would add per-test ceremony for an environment-shaped problem; CI-side config is the right layer.)

Gates (per CLAUDE.md):
- tests: workflow run on the merge commit must be green; verify by pushing and checking gh run
- docs: no doc change needed
- alignment: no spec change; runner identity is a CI hygiene fix
title: CI: configure git identity on GitHub runner so integration tests pass
